claim: The Q3 2026 PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor reports $515.8 billion of US venture investment through September, with AI companies accounting for 82.7 percent of deal value.
verifiedFacts: The PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor reports $515.8 billion in US VC deal value through Q3 2026.
AI companies accounted for 82.7 percent of that deal value; Q3 investment was $98.4 billion across an estimated 5,012 deals.
The report also describes concentrated fundraising and persistent exit constraints.
inference: Consultancy: prioritize revenue-generating implementation and measurable proof over fundraising-dependent speculative platform expansion.
Disposition: Observation Ad Pipeline PRODUCTIZE only with buyer evidence; fragmentary portfolio lines remain CONSOLIDATE candidates, not automatic archive decisions.
AI capital concentration is not evidence that small creative consultancies can access that funding.
significance: High: aggregate funding abundance conceals selective access to capital and favors sellable, bounded service proofs.
assumptions: Concentration persists long enough to affect near-term consultancy go-to-market.
knownLimitations: Investment figures are aggregate estimates and can be revised.
Funding data do not demonstrate specific client budgets or procurement.
